title: After the Mile Championship: Pop-Off Party

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Try as she might, Matikanetannhauser is unable to beat Daitaku Helios! In her frustration, she promises to race her again one day.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Mile Championship comes to a close with an unexpected invitation…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Daitaku Helios invites Matikanetannhauser to her "pop-off party."
